description:
Two to eight separate portfolios measured over one shared window of price history:
        growth, volatility, worst fall, and how each moved against the others. Use it
        for separate portfolios; for a before-and-after of one portfolio,
        test_a_change. Give each portfolio a short label so the answer can refer to
        it; base sets the one currency all are measured in (default USD). Says what
        each was; does not say which to hold.

base.description: Currency every figure is expressed in (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD…). Default USD.
base.title: Base

portfolios.description: Two to eight portfolios, {label: {ticker: weight}}. Labels are shortened to letters and digits.
portfolios.title: Portfolios

name: compare_portfolios

outputSchema.description: Up to eight portfolios measured on one shared window.

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

correlation.description: Per pair of labels: how the portfolios moved together.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

metrics.description: Per portfolio label: growth, volatility, worst fall and related figures.

series.description: Per portfolio label: the growth path over the window.

title: Compare portfolios side by side
